About us

Policybazaar.com is one of India's leading online insurance platforms. It is the flagship platform of PB Fintech, which owns the fintech brand, Paisabazaar.com, and the lending & insurance marketplace in the UAE region, Policybazaar.ae. The Policybazaar.com Group has backing from a host of investors including the likes of PE funds and other family offices. Policybazaar.com started with the purpose to educate people on insurance products and with its offerings has addressed the large and highly underpenetrated online insurance markets.

We’re proud to see our team making a meaningful difference in our customers’ lives.
Kudos to Prantick for his dedication, empathy, and commitment to supporting customers through challenging times.
Stories like these inspire us to keep putting our customers first.

Vaneeta Purohit
3h

Dear PolicyBazaar,

I had a really good experience with Prantick Singh Dhot (PW93278) and wanted to share my appreciation.

I’ve been undergoing ongoing medical treatment, and navigating insurance approvals alongside everything else can be quite stressful. There were a few policy-related complications that needed to be sorted out, and he really went out of his way to help.

He was always approachable, patient with my queries, responsive, and most importantly, followed through until things were resolved. I never felt like I had to keep explaining my situation over and over again.

It’s rare to come across someone who genuinely takes an interest in helping rather than just doing what’s required of them. What I appreciated most was his willingness to take ownership and see things through, rather than simply passing the matter along.

Thank you, Prantick, for being so helpful and considerate. Your support really made a difference during a difficult time, and I truly appreciate it. It made me look at PolicyBazaar as a supportive platform, not just an online aloof aggregate platform.

How can emerging technologies make financial services more inclusive, intelligent, and trustworthy?

At the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur’s #Samanvay2026, Rajiv Kumar Gupta, President, PB Fintech, joined the panel discussion on “Emerging Technologies: Shaping India’s Future in Innovation”, alongside industry leaders Manjush Mathews, Megha Khetarpal, Mohit Malik and Mukesh Jain, with Prof. Jaydharan G Rao as moderator.

Sharing his perspective on the future of fintech, Rajiv spoke about how AI, agentic AI, consent-based data sharing and intelligent fraud prevention can take financial inclusion beyond access to more personalised, secure and relevant financial journeys.

He also emphasised that technology alone cannot create trust. Privacy, transparency, customer control and human judgement must remain at the heart of innovation.

As India’s digital public infrastructure continues to evolve, the next opportunity lies in building intelligence on these foundations, while ensuring that trust grows alongside technology.

Naresh Rana Dr Jitendra Singh Manindra Agrawal  Rajat Sharma

#IITKanpur #Samanvay2026 #Fintech #AI #FinancialInclusion #Innovation

Some moments remind us why health insurance is about so much more than a policy. It's about having one less thing to worry about when life takes an unexpected turn. 
Glad we could be part of this journey, helping the family focus on what matters most.

Pratik Bharda
1d

On Last thursday, my father-in-law complained of chest pain.

We rushed him to CIMS Hospital, Ahmedabad.

The doctors told us he had already had a minor cardiac episode a day before. He hadn’t said a word. Thought it would pass.

CCU. 48 hours. Chairs in a corridor. The quiet terror of watching a monitor through a glass window.

Two beds from him was another family. Father, same age. Same diagnosis. Same ward. Their son hadn’t slept either. We’d nod at each other every time the nurse came out. That silent understanding only two families outside a CCU at 4am can share.

On discharge day, I overheard their conversation at the billing counter.

₹2.5 lakh. Cash. The son stepped away to make calls. His mother was wiping her eyes, not from relief. From the number on that screen.

Our bill: ₹2,39,041. 

Net from our pocket: ₹0.

Full cashless. Aditya Birla Health Insurance settled directly with CIMS. ₹10,000 deposit returned. We signed the discharge papers and walked out.

Same hospital. Same room. Same doctor. Same fear. Same 48 hours.

The only difference was a Sunday evening three years ago when I bought a policy on PolicyBazaar instead of calling an agent.

People in that corridor told me: “𝐎𝐧𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐬𝐞 𝐩𝐨𝐥𝐢𝐜𝐲 𝐦𝐚𝐭 𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐚 𝐛𝐡𝐚𝐢. 𝐀𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐲𝐚 𝐁𝐢𝐫𝐥𝐚 𝐤𝐚 𝐜𝐥𝐚𝐢𝐦 𝐭𝐨𝐡 𝐛𝐚𝐡𝐮𝐭 𝐤𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐛 𝐡𝐨𝐭𝐚 𝐡𝐚𝐢.” 

₹2,39,041. Fully covered.

We all talk about 𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐲 𝐟𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐬 constantly. 6 months of expenses. Parked in savings. Liquid. Safe. Ready.

Nobody tells you that one cardiac event in a private hospital can drain that 𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐫𝐞 𝐟𝐮𝐧𝐝 in 48 hours.

Health insurance is not an expense line in your budget. It is the 𝐟𝐢𝐫𝐬𝐭 𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝐢𝐧 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐧 𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐲 𝐟𝐮𝐧𝐝. The only step that actually scales to the size of the emergency.

There is no real emergency fund without health insurance. There is only the illusion of one.

We obsess over SIPs. We debate old regime vs new regime. We track NAV every morning. But the one product that can protect everything you have built, in a single night without warning, is still treated as optional. Something to buy later. Something the younger generation doesn’t need yet.

Later has a way of arriving without notice.

If you haven’t bought a policy for you and your parents yet, please do it this week. Not next month. This week.

Because the next family in that corridor deserves to walk out the same way we did.

Thank you to the entire team at CIMS Hospital, Ahmedabad. And to Policybazaar.com and Aditya Birla Health Insurance Company Limited you proved every corridor rumour wrong.

#HealthInsurance #PersonalFinance #EmergencyFund #FinancialPlanning #IndiaFinance

Policybazaar.com, this is not customer service. This is repeated follow-up with no ownership.

Last month, when I asked Policybazaar.com about adding my daughter to my existing insurance policy, one of your agents clearly told me:

“Once your daughter completes three months, only then can we add her to the policy.”

I trusted that information and waited until 29 September, when my daughter completed three months.

And then the real problem started.

29 September:
I called Policybazaar to add my daughter.
I was told, “We will arrange a callback.”
No callback.

30 September:
I called again and explained the entire situation.
Again, I was told, “We will arrange a callback.”
Again, no callback.
I then started sending emails and following up repeatedly.
I submitted the provisional Birth Certificate and all the required details and simply asked for the updated payment link. Still no resolution. I was passed from one person to another.

Anshika (PW64662) connected me with Kush Sir (PW22991). I explained the entire story AGAIN.

I was told they were checking with Shukriya. Then I was told: “You will get a call within the next 30 minutes.”

And here I am — still waiting. This is not a complicated request.

I am not asking Policybazaar.com to investigate a complicated insurance claim.
I am asking to ADD MY DAUGHTER TO MY EXISTING POLICY AND PROVIDE THE PAYMENT LINK.

The most frustrating part is that I followed the instructions given by your own team. I waited three months because I was specifically told that this was required. After waiting, I have spent days calling, emailing, explaining the same story to different people and waiting for callbacks that never came.
How many times does a customer need to explain the same problem before someone takes ownership?

Policybazaar.com, if this is your definition of customer support, then customers deserve better. Please stop arranging another “callback” and simply assign someone who will take ownership and close this request.
I am still waiting for the payment link.
